automatic_non_mutations: exact logical replay at same accepted chronology/fingerprint -> run NO_CHANGE/no domain mutation
newer candidate chronology with identical accepted logical fingerprint -> bounded source-check recency/checkpoint update only; no per-entity source observation duplication or domain mutation
proposal whose computed target change set is empty -> system no_change disposition
always_review_or_block: WFM parent RFC correction/adoption with ownership consequence
material WFM source-plan change or operational-plan reconciliation
rationale: The accepted contracts permit safe auto-accept only from an explicit low-risk allowlist but do not require RFC/WFM mutations to auto-accept. Beta 1.0 starts with an empty mutation allowlist until representative operational evidence justifies a separately accepted policy expansion. This does not turn replay/no-op handling into a review burden because those paths mutate no domain authority.
evolution: Any nonempty mutation allowlist requires a new policy version with exact proposal kinds/change classes, risk proof and acceptance fixtures; existing runs retain the policy version used.
